signals.title_or_quote: We have no external uptime monitoring. If Render suspends services and we don't notice, customers suffer.
signals.why_relevant: User needs uptime monitoring as code, which PingDeck provides via Terraform.
signals.drafted_reply: Since you're already weighing UptimeRobot vs Pingdom, one thing worth knowing: UptimeRobot's 60-second interval is their minimum on free plans, and the API is limited enough that managing monitors as code is painful. If your Rekrut_AI infra is Terraform-managed, keeping monitors in a separate click-ops tool creates drift over time. For the status page at status.rekrutai.com and the /api/health check, a tool with a native Terraform provider lets you version-control the whole setup alongside your Render config. I built pingdeck ({APP_URL}) to cover exactly this stack — 30-second intervals, Slack webhooks, and an official Terraform provider — if that fits your workflow.

rescore.why: The thread author is explicitly setting up external uptime monitoring with status pages, Slack alerting, and 60-second ping intervals — exactly what this app provides, and they are actively evaluating UptimeRobot and Pingdom as options.
